questions.stemEn: A child has hypertelorism, a small chin and hypogonadism. Which statement is true regarding the suspected syndrome?

options.text: 90% of affected children are mentally retarded
The diagnosis is made by karyotyping

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يقول إن الملامح أقرب إلى Noonan syndrome، لكنه يصرح بأن كلا الخيارين غير صحيح. لذلك لا نختار إجابة ولا نضيف معلومة غير موجودة في recall.
questions.reasoningEn: The source itself states that the phenotype is most consistent with Noonan syndrome but that neither listed option is correct.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر يرفض الخيارين: intellectual disability ليست بهذه النسبة، وتشخيص Noonan لا يعتمد على routine karyotype.
questions.clinicalPearl: When all recalled options are wrong, preserve the question as conflicting rather than forcing a key.

tts.text: A child has hypertelorism, a small chin and hypogonadism. Which statement is true regarding the suspected syndrome? A. Ninety percent of affected children are mentally retarded. B. The diagnosis is made by karyotyping.

questions.stemEn: A karyotype is provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Klinefelter syndrome اعتمادًا على صورة karyotype. بما أن الصورة غير مرتبطة بعد في البنك، يبقى السؤال blocked حتى تُضاف الصورة الأصلية/public-safe asset.
questions.reasoningEn: The recalled diagnosis depends directly on interpretation of the source karyotype.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن شرح استبعاد بقية الخيارات بدقة دون رؤية karyotype داخل صفحة السؤال المنشورة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Klinefelter syndrome classically has an additional X chromosome, most commonly 47,XXY.

image.captionEn: Original source karyotype is required for diagnosis.

questions.stemEn: A child has gynecomastia, small testes, tall stature and high FSH/LH. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Tall stature + small testes + hypergonadotropic hypogonadism + gynecomastia هي clues كلاسيكية لـKlinefelter syndrome، ومفتاح المصدر 47,XXY.
questions.reasoningEn: The phenotype is classic for Klinefelter syndrome with primary testicular failure and elevated gonadotropins.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: 47,XYY لا يسبب عادةً هذا النمط من hypogonadism/gynecomastia، و46,XXXY كما كُتب في المصدر ليس karyotype طبيعي الصياغة لخيار شائع.
questions.clinicalPearl: Klinefelter often presents around puberty with small firm testes, infertility and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism.

tts.text: A child has gynecomastia, small testes, tall stature and high FSH and LH. What is the most likely diagnosis? A. Forty-seven XXY, Klinefelter syndrome. B. Forty-seven XYY. C. Forty-six XXXY.

questions.stemEn: A child has clinical features of Klinefelter syndrome. Which complication is he at increased risk for?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار breast cancer كcomplication عالية الأهمية في Klinefelter syndrome. Osteoporosis أيضًا معروف ضمن المخاطر المرتبطة hypogonadism، لذلك صيغة 'which complication' تجعل أكثر من خيار clinically relevant؛ نحفظ B كمفتاح recall ونراجع قبل النشر.
questions.reasoningEn: The source key is breast cancer, although osteoporosis is also a recognized Klinefelter-associated risk.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Bleeding tendency ليست association نموذجية. Osteoporosis ليست خيارًا عبثيًا، ولذلك لا نعتبرها خطأ مطلقًا قبل مراجعة صياغة السؤال الأصلية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Klinefelter syndrome carries increased risks related to hypogonadism as well as male breast cancer.

tts.text: A child has clinical features of Klinefelter syndrome. Which complication is he at increased risk for? A. Osteoporosis. B. Breast cancer. C. Bleeding tendency.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Source key B; osteoporosis is also clinically associated and should be considered in review.

questions.stemEn: A 12-year-old boy has weight at the 75th percentile, height at the 95th percentile and Tanner stage 1. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار hypogonadism ويقترح أن tall stature قد يثير احتمال Klinefelter، لكنه يصرح أن العمر 12 سنة مع Tanner 1 لا يطابق بالضرورة تعريف delayed puberty. لذلك السؤال ضعيف ويحتاج مراجعة ولا نثبت diagnosis نهائيًا.
questions.reasoningEn: The source favors hypogonadism but explicitly acknowledges that Tanner stage 1 at age 12 does not necessarily meet delayed-puberty criteria.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Obesity لا يمكن تشخيصها من weight percentile وحده دون BMI. Hyperthyroidism لا يفسر Tanner stage 1 بشكل مباشر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Pubertal delay in boys is usually judged by testicular enlargement and age threshold, not Tanner stage alone without context.

tts.text: A twelve-year-old boy has weight at the seventy-fifth percentile, height at the ninety-fifth percentile and Tanner stage one. What is the most likely diagnosis? A. Obesity. B. Hyperthyroidism. C. Hypogonadism.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Source itself notes the case does not clearly meet delayed-puberty definition.

questions.stemEn: At 13 weeks of gestation, a pregnant woman has elevated alpha-fetoprotein with normal beta-hCG and estradiol. Ultrasound confirms a singleton pregnancy. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار neural tube defect، لكن anencephaly نفسها نوع من open neural tube defect ويمكن أن ترفع AFP؛ لذلك وجود A وC معًا يجعل السؤال potentially multiple-correct. نحفظ مفتاح المصدر فقط ونضعه conflicting.
questions.reasoningEn: Elevated maternal AFP is associated with open neural tube defects, but anencephaly is itself an open neural tube defect, making the options overlapping.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Trisomy 18 و13 لا يمثلان التفسير النموذجي لـisolated elevated AFP، لكن option C overlaps directly with A.
questions.clinicalPearl: When a broad category and one of its specific examples both appear as options, the MCQ may be structurally flawed.

questions.stemEn: Which of the following is an indication for genetic counseling?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يكتب أن A هو 'most likely' أو B أيضًا ممكن. لذلك لا نفرض إجابة واحدة. Advanced maternal age وadvanced paternal age قد يكونان أسبابًا للإحالة حسب السياق، بينما family history غير المحددة لـliver cirrhosis لا تكفي وحدها دون suspected inherited disorder.
questions.reasoningEn: The source explicitly considers both advanced maternal and paternal age as potentially valid counseling indications.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا نعد B خطأ لأن المصدر نفسه يراه ممكنًا. C غير محدد وراثيًا بما يكفي في صياغته الحالية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Genetic counseling indications depend on reproductive history, parental ages, family history and specific suspected inherited conditions.
